en: An illustrated postcard showing a soldier in uniform standing beside a horse-drawn artillery cart. Two horses, covered with blankets, are depicted – one is eating from a pile of hay. The vehicle and attire suggest a World War I era military theme. The frame of the card is decorated with a red, white, and black checkered border. There are two lines of text in German ('KANON-ANSPANN') and Finnish ('TYKISTÖVALJAKKO'), and a handwritten destination or date ('HAGA 13/4 1918'). The lower right corner includes an artist's signature.
